about: Every OBP-API call that the Portal, API Manager, Cohort and the shared package make from their source code. Each entry gives the verb, the path (OBP placeholders in capitals), the source file, the text in that file that makes the call (needles) and the response fields the code reads. packages/shared/src/lib/server/obp/obpApiContract.test.ts checks this list against the source and against snapshot.json, which obp-api-contract/snapshot.py writes from an OBP-API's resource docs. not_calls lists source lines that name an OBP-API path without calling it, such as help text, example code and path helpers whose calls are listed at their callers. Not listed: calls through the generic proxy (/proxy/obp/...) whose path the browser or the route chooses at run time, records of the Dynamic Entities the apps define themselves (/obp/dynamic-entity/... and their v7.0.0 bank-level form), and dynamic endpoints. Not covered yet: the Berlin Group and UK Open Banking calls of the Portal, because snapshot.py reads only OBP resource docs.
